claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the communication connection between the target device and the trusted device is for exchanging ranging information to determine whether the target device and the trusted device are within a particular range prior to exchanging authorization information to modify a security state of the target device.

3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the proxy device announces the availability of the trusted device using a first wireless protocol and the communication connection established between the target device and the trusted device uses a different, second wireless protocol.
4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the proxy device maintains a connection with the trusted device using the first wireless protocol.

5. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the announcing, by the proxy device, the availability of the trusted device comprises broadcasting, by the proxy device, an identifier for the target device.
6. A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by a set of processing units causes the set of processing units to perform operations comprising:

7. The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 6, wherein the scanning, sending, and exchanging are performed using a first wireless protocol, wherein the communication connection is established to use a different, second wireless protocol.

8. The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 6 or claim 7, wherein upon receiving the first request, the proxy device instructs the particular trusted device to initiate a broadcast of its availability.
9. The non-transitory machine readable medium of any of claims 6 to 8, wherein the proxy device is in a locked state and the trusted device is in an unlocked state.

10. The non-transitory machine readable medium of any of claims 6 to 9, wherein establishing the communication connection comprises exchanging bootstrap information with the particular trusted device, wherein the bootstrap information identifies a portion of a frequency spectrum for the communication connection.
11. The non-transitory machine readable medium of any of claims 6 to 10, wherein the program further comprises sets of instructions for:
12. The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 11, wherein the change in security state moves the target device from a locked state to an unlocked state.

13. The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 11 or 12, wherein the target device is allowed to receive the set of authentication information when the trusted device is determined to be within a particular threshold distance based on the set of ranging operations.

14. The non-transitory machine readable medium of any of claims 11 to 13, wherein the trusted device sends the set of authentication information when the target device is determined to be within a particular threshold distance based on the set of ranging operations.
a memory; and at least one processor configured to perform the method of any of claims 1-14.
